mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reflects a tighter monetary policy that increases the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for FEDFUNDS level remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS is above 4.0% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 4.5% signals an economic slowdown that triggers central bank rate cuts, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5%, or the signal's Rank IC drops below 0.02 over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate robust aggregate demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS and HOUST both exceed 0.0% MoM, or the interaction signal's Rank IC falls below 0.01 over a 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 indicates a manufacturing contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days during early recession cycles.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0, or the signal's Rank IC falls below 0.01 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading above 3.5% annually signals persistent inflation, prompting delayed monetary tightening that results in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.5%, or the signal's Rank IC remains below 0.02 over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate a strong labor market that boosts consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when both PAYEMS and UNRATE meet the trigger condition, or the interaction signal's Rank IC drops below 0.01 over a 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%), the central bank maintains restrictive policy, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.5%, or the signal's Rank IC falls below 0.01 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing activity, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for INDPRO level remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO is above 100.0 (t-test p > 0.05).
